page_title: BAY 4-2 STU | Bayern Munich v Stuttgart 19/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Great chance! Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
90+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

88' 4 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) fires a brilliant volley into the top left corner from the edge of the box, leaving the goalkeeper helpless. Atakan Karazor provided the assist. What a finish! 4:2.
85' Substitution. Deniz Ofli (Bayern Munich) on for Josip Stanisic.
85' It's time for a substitution. Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) comes on in place of Tiago Tomas.
76' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Raphael Guerreiro is replaced by Bara Ndiaye (Bayern Munich).
76' It will be a substitution. Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) is ready to enter the pitch as Jamie Leweling walks off.

73' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) finds himself some space inside the box to connect with the resulting corner kick. He fires the ball towards the top left corner, but his effort is blocked by the defender. Maybe next time.
73' Bayern Munich earn a corner.
72' The referee awards a corner and Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) goes over to take it.

70' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Jonas Urbig pulls off a comfortable save.
67' That was close by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
65' Here comes a substitution. Chema Andres (VfB Stuttgart) is brought on as a substitute for Angelo Stiller.
65' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Chris Fuhrich.
62' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alphonso Davies.
60' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) will take the corner.
60' The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
52' 4 - 1 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 4:1.
52' The ball is out of play and Bayern Munich manage to earn a corner.
48' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayern Munich.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Luis Diaz is replaced by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich).
46' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) comes on the pitch for Jamal Musiala.
46' Sebastian Hoeness is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Finn Jeltsch suffers an injury and Luca Jaquez (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
46' Soren Storks blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar.
45+1' The opposition can't get near Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.

44' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The linesman makes the right call and Bayern Munich will have a corner.
43' A snap shot by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) from the edge of the area flies towards the top left corner, but Jonas Urbig produces a good save to thwart him.

39' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
37' 3 - 1 Goal! Luis Diaz plays it to Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Alexander Nubel. 3:1.

33' 2 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Luis Diaz, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich), who beats Alexander Nubel with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:1.

31' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) darts into the box to collect a fantastic lofted pass from Jamal Musiala and unleashes a powerful shot directed into the roof of the net. The ball bounces in off the crossbar, increasing the score of today's match. It's now 1:1.
31' Bayern Munich have a corner.
28' The referee signals a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
28' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Now Bayern Munich have a corner.
23' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
21' 0 - 1 Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom right corner, leaving the keeper helpless.
15' It will be a corner kick for Stuttgart.
12' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Jonas Urbig makes a save.

10' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Alexander Nubel displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
9' Bayern Munich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
9' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) will deliver the corner kick.
8' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Stuttgart.
6' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.

The players are out at last! Bayern Munich will take the kick-off.
